name: UUID Generator
description: Generate cryptographically random UUID v4 identifiers — one at a time or in bulk — entirely in your browser.

faq.question: What version of UUID does this generate?
faq.answer: Version 4 — 122 random bits (the remaining 6 bits are fixed by the UUID v4 spec to mark the version and variant), generated with the Web Crypto API's crypto.getRandomValues(), not Math.random(). Collisions are astronomically unlikely: about a 50% chance after generating a billion billion of them.

faq.question: Can I generate more than one at a time?
faq.answer: Yes — set the count field up to 100 and every UUID generates in one batch, ready to copy as a list.

faq.question: Are the generated UUIDs sent anywhere or logged?
faq.answer: No — generation happens entirely in your browser. ToolHub has no backend to send them to.
